text: Sit in the shade a moment. Water first, questions after.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: You walked the sands and came back. Drink. Then tell me everything.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: This sun-baked island and its three black stones are in my keeping.
The stones are old. Older than the tower, some say. I only dust them.
The three-headed undead destroys all who trespass into his eroded world, guarding the remains of his long-lost friends.
The sands beyond are endless and thirsty.
Nobody knows for certain. There is only the old saying:
“He hates the open sky, and anything that shines in it.”
Make of it what you will. I've said too much already.
Water is life there, and wasted water is death.
Old camps, crypts and a temple of a buried king hide in the dunes. Maps are found, not given.
